description: A computed projection reports its SEMI-STRUCTURED static type so a direct CTAS declares the column the way live does (OBJECT_CONSTRUCT -> OBJECT, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT -> ARRAY, PARSE_JSON -> VARIANT, OBJECT_KEYS -> ARRAY per the producer), through derived tables, empty selects, FROM-less selects and views alike - while every OTHER family keeps its value-derived recovery (the decimal-scale guard: CTAS of 1.5 stores 1.5, not a bare-NUMBER-rounded 2; arithmetic NUMBER, comparison BOOLEAN, string TEXT). Converted 1:1 from expressions/ProjectedColumnTypeTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE proj_src (id INTEGER)
INSERT INTO proj_src VALUES (1)
CREATE TABLE p_obj AS SELECT OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('k','v') AS c FROM proj_src
SELECT data_type FROM test_db.information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'P_OBJ'
CREATE TABLE proj_src (id INTEGER)
INSERT INTO proj_src VALUES (1)
CREATE TABLE p_arr AS SELECT ARRAY_CONSTRUCT(1, 2) AS c FROM proj_src
SELECT data_type FROM test_db.information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'P_ARR'
CREATE TABLE proj_src (id INTEGER)
INSERT INTO proj_src VALUES (1)
CREATE TABLE p_var AS SELECT PARSE_JSON('{"a":1}') AS c FROM proj_src
SELECT data_type FROM test_db.information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'P_VAR'
CREATE TABLE proj_src (id INTEGER)
INSERT INTO proj_src VALUES (1)
CREATE TABLE p_keys AS SELECT OBJECT_KEYS(OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('k','v')) AS c FROM proj_src
